czechia.summary: Zpráva neziskové organizace UN Watch odhalila rozsáhlé vměšování autoritářských států do práce zvláštních zpravodajů OSN. U každého pátého z nich vyšetřování poukázalo na přijímání vysokých finančních obnosů a vstřícné vystupování vůči dárcovským zemím. Někteří zpravodajové tak prosazují agendu zemí, jako je Rusko, Čína nebo Katar. OSN se zatím nevyjádřila.

romania.title: România și alte cinci state UE cer înghețarea certificatelor gratuite de CO2. Companiile se tem de relocări în afara UE
romania.summary: România s-a alăturat unui grup de șase state membre ale Uniunii Europene care solicită Comisiei Europene să încetinească reducerea certificatelor gratuite de emisii de CO2 acordate industriei, argumentând că prețurile ridicate la energie și efectele războiului din Iran pun în pericol competitivitatea unor sectoare economice esențiale.

romania.title: UE nu are încă în plan numirea unui negociator-șef pentru discuțiile de pace dintre Ucraina și Rusia
romania.summary: Uniunea Europeană nu intenționează, deocamdată, să numească un negociator-șef pentru eventualele discuții de pace dintre Ucraina și Rusia, au declarat înalți oficiali și diplomați ai UE, citați de dpa.

romania.title: Meteorologii au emis noi avertizări de ploi și vânt puternic. HARTA zonelor afectate de cod galben și vremea în București
romania.summary: Administrația Națională de Meteorologie (ANM) a emis, joi, o informare de ploi torențiale, descărcări electrice și intensificări ale vântului, precum și două coduri galbene de vânt puternic pentru mai multe regiuni din țară.

romania.title: Șeful IEA avertizează Europa: Revenirea la energia rusească ar fi „o greșeală majoră” în „cea mai mare criză energetică din istorie”
romania.summary: Directorul Agenției Internaționale pentru Energie (IEA), Fatih Birol, avertizează că Europa nu trebuie să revină la dependența de energia rusească, în contextul noii crize provocate de blocarea Strâmtorii Ormuz și de explozia prețurilor la petrol și gaze. Oficialul spune că o relaxare a sancțiunilor împotriva Moscovei ar repeta „greșelile trecutului” și ar afecta securitatea energetică a continentului.

romania.title: Kaja Kallas avertizează că Rusia vrea „să întindă o capcană Uniunii Europene”: „Să nu cădem în ea”
romania.summary: Şefa diplomaţiei europene, Kaja Kallas, a avertizat joi că Uniunea Europeană nu ar trebui să cadă în „capcana” Rusiei de a dezbate numirea unui mediator european pentru războiul din Ucraina, relatează AFP şi Reuters.

romania.title: Ilie Bolojan, vizită în Republica Moldova: întrevederi cu Maia Sandu și premierul Alexandru Munteanu
romania.summary: Prim-ministrul interimar Ilie Bolojan va face, vineri o vizită în Republica Moldova, unde va avea întrevederi cu președinta Maia Sandu și cu premierul Alexandru Munteanu, potrivit agendei oficiale prezentate de Guvern.

romania.title: Pactul dintre Marea Britanie și Polonia arată că Europa își construiește securitatea în afara vechilor instituții
romania.summary: Păstrați-vă calmul și semnați încă un tratat. Aceasta pare din ce în ce mai mult a fi doctrina de securitate a Europei într-o nouă eră de incertitudine strategică, în care guvernele nu mai pornesc de la premisa că vechile garanții de securitate, alianțele și instituțiile vor rămâne automat în vigoare, comentează TVPWorld. romania.summary: Donald Trump a anunţat miercuri că îl susţine pe prim-ministrul Nikol Paşinian în alegerile parlamentare din 7 iunie din Armenia, un scrutin care reprezintă un test pentru guvernul acestei ţări din Caucaz, care a făcut recent o schimbare de direcţie către Occident şi s-a distanţat de Rusia.

romania.summary: O călătorie în zona București-Ilfov, cu un mijloc de transport în comun, nu este o experiență de constanță. romania.summary: Prim-ministrul suedez Ulf Kristersson va anunța joi transferul de avioane de luptă Jas 39 Gripen către Ucraina în cadrul unei conferințe de presă care va avea loc la baza aeriană Uppland din Uppsala. Avioanele în cauză sunt din varianta C/D, relatează portalul suedez Aftonbladet.

romania.title: Centrul de Servicii Globale P&G România, iHub, marchează 20 de ani și devine strategic, cu rol global
romania.summary: În urmă cu două decenii s-a lansat din București una dintre cele mai puternice transformări din rețeaua globală P&G. romania.summary: Două serii jurnalistice publicate de HotNews au fost premiate miercuri seară în cadrul celei de-a 15-a ediții a Premiilor Superscrieri.  Redacția Recorder a fost marele câștigător al celei de-a 15 ediții a Premiilor Superscrieri organizate de Fundația Friends for Friends (FFFF), miercuri seară, la Clubul Diplomatic din București. estonia.title: Tallinn water bills to rise for households, fall for businesses
estonia.summary: Tallinn's water supplier Tallinn Vesi is to raise household water bills by nearly €2 per month.

estonia.title: Estonia's Finance Minister pushes back against populist spending proposals
estonia.summary: Finance Minister Jürgen Ligi said his main challenge at the moment is drafting the next state budget, as many politicians are looking to use taxpayer money to offer pre-election giveaways to voters. Estonian parliamentary elections will take place in March 2027.

estonia.title: Proposed amendment would allow authorities to restrict media during wartime
estonia.summary: Under current rules in Estonia, the right to restrict the media during a state of war rests with decisions made by the parliament. However, a bill currently under consideration would extend that authority to the Consumer Protection and Technical Regulatory Authority (TTJA), the Police and Border Guard Board (PPA), the Internal Security Service, and the Defense Forces.

estonia.title: Restored altarpiece reinstalled in Võru County church
estonia.summary: A large altarpiece in a South Estonian church has been restored and returned after a challenging, three-month-long job.

estonia.title: Security experts dismiss media speculation about Russian attack on Baltic states
estonia.summary: Estonian security experts have dismissed claims circulating in the Western media that Russia is preparing to attack the Baltic states in the near future, arguing the coverage does not critically assess Russia's messaging.

estonia.title: Police detain suspects in €700,000 Artists' Association scam
estonia.summary: Police detained two men on Monday suspected of involvement in the theft of €700,000 from the Estonian Artists' Association.

estonia.title: Tallinn to renovate Lembitu Park and install smart lighting
estonia.summary: The City of Tallinn will fully renovate Lembitu Park in central Tallinn, installing Estonia's first multifunctional direct-current lighting network to boost energy efficiency and celebrate the area's history.

estonia.title: Tallinn awarded 'Rescuer City' title for supporting Ukraine
estonia.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has awarded Estonia's capital, Tallinn, the honorary title of "Rescuer City" for its support for Ukraine.

estonia.title: Eliisa Pass: The history of Estonia's forest landscapes does not justify a policy of devastation
estonia.summary: The forest law being planned by the government promises to deepen the overharvesting of Estonia's forests. Time and again, decision-makers justify this by saying, "Estonia has never had as much forest as it does now," writes Eliisa Pass.

estonia.title: Estonian court convicts man for sanctions evasion over Baltnews content
estonia.summary: Viru District Court found Aleksei Toom guilty of continuing to serve the economic interests of Russian media conglomerate Russia Today despite international sanctions, by writing articles for the Baltnews portal.

estonia.title: Estonian swimmers on winning form in London
estonia.summary: The final day of the AP Race International in London brought triumph for three of Estonia's top swimmers.

estonia.title: Estonia's diplomats will not leave Kyiv despite Russian threats
estonia.summary: Estonian diplomats will stay in the Ukrainian capital amid threats of new attacks from Russia, Minister of Foreign Affairs Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) has said.

estonia.title: Estonia's Ministry of Climate forcing food donation contracts on supermarkets
estonia.summary: The Ministry of Climate plans to require grocery stores to sign food donation agreements. Retailers and the food industry, however, do not believe they can significantly further reduce food waste.

estonia.title: Head producer of Eurovision: Russia will definitely not return
estonia.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest held in Vienna a few weeks ago was the first with Estonian Gert Kark as head producer, after having worked with Eurovision for ten years. Looking back on his first year in the role, Kark said his new position has actually made his life easier.

estonia.title: EV sales not keeping pace with Estonia's charging infrastructure development
estonia.summary: Estonia's electric vehicle charging network has grown more than tenfold over the past four years, while sales of electric cars have not seen a similarly sharp rise.

estonia.title: How has Estonia chosen its presidents?
estonia.summary: Veteran journalist Kärt Anvelt and former journalist Toomas Sildam look back at Estonia's presidential elections since 1992, exploring how political dynamics and evolving electoral rules have shaped the country's leadership over the past three decades.

estonia.title: Officials: Illegal border crossings from Russia into Estonia have mostly disappeared
estonia.summary: Illegal border crossings from the Russian Federation into Estonia have largely halted, officials say.

estonia.title: Suurprogramm toob Eesti tervishoidu 14 miljonit ja raviotsustesse geeniandmed
estonia.summary: Eesti käivitab uue rahvatervise programmi, mille eesmärk on parandada inimeste tervist ja heaolu ning muuta ennetavad tegevused ja abi kättesaadavamaks. Programmi kogumaht on üle 14 miljoni euro, millest suurem osa tuleb Euroopa Majanduspiirkonna toetustest, mida rahastavad Norra, Island ja Liechtenstein.

estonia.title: Ukrainlased laulatati Eestis ja nende peres sündis ime: «Jalad ei kanna, pisarad voolavad!»

estonia.title: Outdated insolvency proceedings system could turn Estonia into a springboard for crime
estonia.summary: Serious management failures and weak accountability rules are enabling irresponsible business practices, with the average abandoned debt left behind by insolvent, assetless companies climbing to €385,000, the Insolvency Service warns.

estonia.summary: Eesti korvpallimeistrivõistluste finaalis pakutakse spordisõpradele täie raha eest meelelahutust. Igas mõttes.

estonia.title: Norra kipub Prantsusmaa tuumavihmavarju alla

Plaan peegeldab Euroopa kasvavat muret sõltuvuse pärast Ameerika Ühendriikidest julgeoleku tagamisel, vahendab Reuters.

Selgele vajadusele vastamiseks käivitab Tervisekassa koostöös partneritega pilootprojekti «Teejuht», et tugevdada koolide võimekust ennetada vaimse tervise riske.

estonia.title: OTSEBLOGI ⟩ Jaapani ralli: Toyota näitas juba testikatsel võimu, Jürgenson omas klassis teine
estonia.summary: Autoralli MM-hooaja viimane asfaldietapp sõidetakse juba sel nädalavahetusel Jaapanis. Võistlus algas Eesti aja järgi neljapäeva varahommikul tesitkatsega, tõsiseks madinaks läheb reedel. Postimees vahendab sündmusi otseblogis.

estonia.title: Experts: Russia does not have the strength for military escalation
estonia.summary: Estonian experts have said Russia does not have the strength to escalate militarily after speculation in international media that Moscow could bring the war to Europe.

estonia.title: Kirjandusfestival HeadRead täidab Tallinna vestluste, muusika ja jalutuskäikudega

estonia.title: A literary festival HeadRead kicks off in Tallinn
estonia.summary: The Tallinn International Literary Festival HeadRead brings talks, author meet-and-greets, and musical performances to the Writers' House from May 27 to 31. estonia.title: Rahvusraamatukogu suure avamiseni on jäänud täpselt aasta
estonia.summary: 28. mail jääb aasta päevani, mil Eesti Rahvusraamatukogu avab täiemahuliselt oma uksed Tõnismäel. Kuni suure avamiseni 2027. aasta mai lõpus on hoone osaliselt avatud haridus- ja sündmuskeskuse tegevusteks ning raamatuid saab laenutamiseks tellida ESTER kataloogi kaudu.

estonia.summary: Venemaal sündinud supermodell Natalia Vodianova on taas rase. Naine ootab oma kuuendat last, kelle isaks on miljardärist abikaasa, kes kuulub ühte maailma kõige rikkamasse perekonda.

estonia.title: Former EDF chief questions delay in assigning Dutch-German corps to Baltics
estonia.summary: Former Commander of the Estonian Defence Forces Martin Herem has said the sooner the formal decision to assign the Dutch-German Corps to the region is made, the better, as it will temporarily reduce capabilities.

latvia.title: US Congressman Don Bacon receives Latvian state award
latvia.summary: May 27th saw Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs presenting Latvia’s highest state award – the Order of the Three Stars – to Don Bacon, a member of the U.S. Congress House of Representatives and long-time co-chair of the Baltic Caucus.

latvia.title: Dutch military signs up to use Latvian drone testing range
latvia.summary: For the second year in a row, industry, armed forces and policymakers from Latvia and elsewhere have been meeting at the Drone Summit in Rīga, where a memorandum on closer cooperation in the field of defence innovation, testing and training was signed with the Netherlands on Wednesday. It stipulates that the Dutch armed forces will use the new Sēlija military training ranges for military exercises.

latvia.title: Kamēr visā pasaulē runā par mieru, Zelenskis gatavojas citam scenārijam
latvia.summary: Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis uzskata, ka Krievijas sāktais karš pret Ukrainu varētu ilgt vēl divus līdz trīs gadus, un devis rīkojumu valstij gatavoties turpmākai agresijas atvairīšanai. Par to, atsaucoties uz anonīmiem avotiem Ukrainas valdībā, ziņo britu izdevums The Economist. latvia.summary: Augšdaugavas novadā aizturēts Latvijas pilsonis, kurš, bēgot no robežsargiem, mēģināja pārvadāt piecas nelegāli robežu šķērsojušas personas. Robežsargi Tabores pagastā mēģināja pārbaudei apturēt kādu “Nissan” markas automašīnu, taču tās vadītājs nepakļāvās robežsargu likumīgai prasībai un turpināja braukt. latvia.title: “Mēnesnīca” atklāj jauno sezonu: pavisam drīz jau gaidāms pirmais koncerts
latvia.summary: Ogres novada, Turkalnē, jau ceturto gadu pēc kārtas savu sezonu uzsāk kultūrtelpa “Mēnesnīca”, piedāvājot unikālu koncertpieredzi dabas ieskautā, intīmā un meditatīvā vidē. “Mēnesnīca” ir kļuvusi par īpašu satikšanās vietu mūzikas un iekšējās izaugsmes cienītājiem – koncertvakari norisinās saulrieta laikā, ļaujot saplūst mūzikai, dabai un klusumam. latvia.summary: Ir cilvēki, kas gatavi apsolīt zvaigznes no debesīm, bet tālāk par tukšiem solījumiem netiek. Citi maz runā, bet dara, neko neaizmirst un ir ļoti mērķtiecīgi. latvia.summary: “Par tā sauktajiem kropļu bataljonu gājieniem ir parādījies daudz informācijas,” tā TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” sacīja Jānis Slaidiņš, NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks. latvia.summary: Krievija paziņojusi par nodomu vērsties Starptautiskajā Tiesā saistībā ar it kā notiekošu “krievu apspiešanu” Latvijā, Lietuvā un Igaunijā. latvia.summary: Rīgas valstspilsētas pašvaldības Ārtelpas un mobilitātes departaments (ĀMD) 2026. gada 26. februārī izsludināja iepirkumu Rīgas ielu apgaismojuma ESKO dokumentācijas izstrādei. latvia.summary: Izraēla šodien apstiprināja, ka dienu iepriekš veiktajā gaisa triecienā Gazas pilsētā likvidēts palestīniešu grupējuma “Hamās” bruņotā spārna jaunais vadītājs Mohammeds Odehs. latvia.title: Rhododendrons bloom magnificently at Latvian botanical gardens
latvia.summary: The vibrant rhododendron blooming season has begun at the University of Latvia (LU) Botanical Garden at both of its locations in Rīga and Babīte, according to garden representatives. Together, the two sites form the largest rhododendron collection in the Baltics.

latvia.title: Vai Rosļikovs kā personība var būt izdevīgs Krievijai? Politologs vērš uzmanību uz vienu svarīgu niansi
latvia.summary: “Vai Aleksejs Rosļikovs kā personība var būt izdevīgs Krievijai, ja viņi izdomātu šeit nodibināt kaut kādu DNR jeb Doņeckas republikas modeli?” Šādu jautājumu TV24 raidījumā “Ziņu TOP” uzdeva Filipam Rajevskim, politologam. Viņš norāda, ka šāds scenārijs neesot viennozīmīgi interpretējams, bet viņa atbilde ir: “Nē, noteikti nē – viņš jau nav latvietis,” viņš politologs, vienlaikus pievēršoties […]

latvia.title: Tourists are afraid to visit Latvia's eastern Latgale region
latvia.summary: Evidence is growing that recent events near Latvia's eastern border – repeated drone incidents, regular airspace threat warnings, mobile phone alerts, NATO fighter jets being scrambled – are having serious consequences for the tourism industry, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Joint wind orchestra to come together in Balvi, Latvia
latvia.summary: When dozens of trumpets, tubas, and saxophones play together, wind music becomes not only something to be heard, but also something to be felt. On Saturday, May 30, wind orchestras from Vidzeme and Latgale will come together in the eastern town of Balvi for the concert "Skanēt savā laikā" (Sound of Our Time).

latvia.title: Riga Airport reports improved profit
latvia.summary: RIX Riga Airport maintained stable operational performance in 2025 and closed the financial year with a profit of EUR 4.2 million, EUR 0.8 million higher than the previous year, according to the company’s audited annual report for 2025, released on May 26th.

latvia.title: Latvia still has a lot of work regarding LGBTIA+ rights
latvia.summary: An annual European ranking table published by ILGA-Europe, an LGBTIA+ (lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, asexual, and other non-conforming identities) rights advocacy group, as usual, places Latvia slightly above Lithuania but way below Estonia when it comes to rights for LGBTIA+ people.

latvia.title: Latvia in search of new chancellery head
latvia.summary: Not only must Latvia select a new Prime Minister, but also the highest-ranking public official – the Director of the State Chancellery. The two previous holders of the position were forced to step down. Jānis Citskovskis is already on trial, while criminal proceedings have been initiated against Raivis Kronbergs. Now a successor must be chosen for this important position, Latvian Television reported on May 26.

latvia.title: Tourists like Latvia in July, not so much in February
latvia.summary: The importance of the summer season to Latvia's tourist trade is underlined in fresh Eurostat figures.

latvia.title: Latvia will face Norway next at ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: Having secured a place in the IIHF ice hockey world championship quarter finals, it is now clear that Latvia's opponents will be Norway.

latvia.title: Illegal migrants caught in Ogre forest, far from Latvian border
latvia.summary: For the first time in Birzgale Parish, Ogre Municipality – in central Latvia, not in a border region – eight people who had entered Latvia illegally were detained this week, Latvian Television reported on May 27.

latvia.title: Regular train service restored on Rīga-Tukums line
latvia.summary: It has become easier and faster for passengers on the Tukums and Skulte railway lines to reach their destinations, as six-month-long repairs on these lines, which significantly impacted electric train service, have been completed, Latvian Radio reported on May 27.

latvia.title: Wind, hail, thunder to tear through Latvia Wednesday
latvia.summary: On Wednesday, northwesterly winds across Latvia will intensify to 15–20 metres per second in gusts; the strongest gusts may uproot trees in some areas, forecasters warn.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 26th May, 2026
latvia.summary: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: PM candidate Kulbergs names Latvia's new government
latvia.summary: Prime Minister candidate Andris Kulbergs (United List) has officially announced the composition of the incoming government on Tuesday, May 26. This has also been confirmed by President Edgars Rinkēvičs.

latvia.title: Eight is great! Latvia through to knockout stages of ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: Latvia's young ice hockey team turned on the style against Hungary on Tuesday to definitively seal a spot in the knockout stages of the IIHF ice hockey world championships in Switzerland.

latvia.title: Latvia has EU's second highest at-risk-of-poverty rate
latvia.summary: Fresh Eurostat data show Latvia having the second highest at-risk-of-poverty (AROP) rate in the European Union (EU) in 2025.

latvia.title: Over 1,300 students had exams postponed due to air threats in Latvia
latvia.summary: Approximately 1,350 pupils will take the second part of the Latvian language exam during the extended testing period, as their exams last week were disrupted by a potential airspace threat, according to information available to the State Education Development Agency (VIAA).

latvia.title: Distinguished scientist Juris Upatnieks has died
latvia.summary: On May 17, 2026, the outstanding physicist of Latvian origin, founder of holography, and foreign member of the Latvian Academy of Sciences (LAS), Professor Juris Upatnieks, passed away, the LAS announced.

latvia.title: Latvians work longer hours than Estonians, shorter hours than Lithuanians
latvia.summary: In 2025, the actual weekly working hours of EU full-time and part-time workers aged 20-64 in their main job averaged 35.9 hours, down from 36.9 hours in 2015, according to the latest Eurostat statistics.

latvia.title: Latvia in global top 50 for startups
latvia.summary: The latest StartupBlink Global Startup Ecosystem Index 2026 report has been published and places Latvia in 48th place worldwide, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: It's Latvia versus Norway at ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: The approval of a new government is only the second most-important thing of the day in Latvia on Thursday, with the national ice hockey team taking on Norway in the IIHF world championships in Switzerland this evening.

latvia.title: Latvia's new coalition pledges to work together
latvia.summary: Representatives of the political parties forming the new coalition – the United List (AS), the National Alliance (NA), New Unity (JV), and the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) – signed a coalition agreement and a declaration on the government’s planned activities on Thursday morning, LSM.lv reports.

latvia.title: Progressives: ZZS staying in Agriculture Ministry unacceptable
latvia.summary: The Union of Greens and Farmers continuing to lead the Ministry of Agriculture is unacceptable, stated Andris Šuvajevs, the leader of the opposition faction Progressives, on Thursday, May 28, on the Latvian Television programme Morning Panorama.

latvia.title: More anti-mobility barriers deployed on Latvian border
latvia.summary: This month, the National Armed Forces (NBS) began deploying the first anti-mobility barriers, so-called dragon's teeth, on the expropriated territories along the Latvian-Russian border, LSM's Latgale editorial reports on May 28.

latvia.title: Thursday will be just as windy in Latvia
latvia.summary: On Thursday, northwesterly winds will pick up again in Latvia, with gusts only slightly weaker than those experienced on Wednesday, forecasters warn.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 27th May, 2026
latvia.summary: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

lithuania.title: Lenkijos pasieniečiai pasienyje su Lietuva sulaikė 14 neteisėtų migrantų
lithuania.summary: Lenkijos pasieniečiai pranešė apie dar vieną neteisėtos migracijos atvejį pasienyje su Lietuva. Per vieną dieną Podlaskės vaivadijoje sulaikyta 14 užsieniečių, neteisėtai kirtusių Lietuvos ir Lenkijos sieną, skelbia miastosuwalki.pl.

lithuania.title: Latvijos pasienyje su Rusija išdygo „drakono dantys“
lithuania.summary: Latvijos ginkluotosios pajėgos šį mėnesį pasienyje su Rusija pradėjo dislokuoti judėjimą stabdančias kliūtis, vadinamuosius drakono dantis, ketvirtadienį pranešė transliuotojas LSM.

lithuania.title: Kvietimas Rusijai pulti: ekspertai įspėjo apie naują pavojų
lithuania.summary: Dar 2025 metais oficialiai anonsuotas planas mažinti JAV indėlį į realią Europos saugumo infrastruktūrą įgyja konkrečius pavidalus. Apie tai rašo naujienų portalas „Defense Express“.

lithuania.title: Vladimiras Laučius. Kuo baigsis karas Ukrainoje?
lithuania.summary: Rusijai vis labiau klimpstant į neišsprendžiamas problemas ir karo Ukrainoje frontuose, ir nuosavos degraduojančios ekonomikos pelkėje, jos pradėtas plataus masto karas nebeteikia Maskvai šviesos tunelio gale vilčių. Nusivylimo ir desperacijos nuotaikos
